kpis.name: E-RAB accessibility
kpis.operators_differ: Which RRC establishment causes count (mobile-originated only, or all including emergency and signalling), and whether the S1 term is included.

kpis.name: E-RAB retainability (R2, UE level)
kpis.operators_differ: Per QCI (R1) or per UE (R2); many operators report a drop rate per established E-RAB instead (LTE_ERAB_DROP). The Huawei-style dictionary carries no session-time counter, so it is computed for Nokia-style cells only.

kpis.name: E-UTRAN IP throughput, downlink
kpis.operators_differ: Whether the last TTI emptying the buffer is excluded (TS 32.450 excludes it); many operators also report cell throughput over the whole period.

kpis.name: E-UTRAN cell availability
kpis.operators_differ: Whether planned maintenance and energy-saving shutdowns count as unavailable. Nokia-style availability is sampled every 10 s (ASSUMPTION), so its unavailable time has 10 s resolution.

kpis.name: E-UTRAN mobility (handover success)
kpis.formula: 100 * sum over neighbour relations of HO.OutSuccTarget.sum / sum of HO.OutAttTarget.sum
kpis.source: 3GPP TS 32.450 V19.0.0 clause 6.5.1, execution phase: its HO.ExeSucc / HO.ExeAtt mapped to the TS 32.425 per-relation HO.OutSuccTarget / HO.OutAttTarget
kpis.operators_differ: Whether the preparation phase is included (TS 32.450 includes it; the model has no preparation counters) and whether inter-RAT handovers count.

kpis.name: RRC setup success rate
kpis.operators_differ: Establishment causes counted; whether re-attempts within a few seconds count once; whether the S1 signalling connection must also succeed (v2).

kpis.name: E-RAB drop rate
kpis.operators_differ: Which release causes count as drops (ERAB.RelActNbr counts abnormal releases with data in the buffer) and the denominator (established E-RABs, incoming handovers included or not).

kpis.name: DL PRB utilization
kpis.operators_differ: Mean over all periods or over the busy hour only; DL only or DL and UL.

kpis.name: Mean downlink wideband CQI
kpis.formula: sum over bins i of i * CARR.WBCQIDist.Bin[i] / sum of CARR.WBCQIDist.Bin[i] (CQI index 0 to 15, TS 36.213 Table 7.2.3-1)
kpis.operators_differ: Mean index or share of samples at CQI 7 and above. Reported hourly (rules P1, P4), so it has no 15-minute value.

kpis.name: GERAN service access success rate, CS
kpis.operators_differ: TS 32.410 excludes SDCCH set-up repetitions; vendor counters often do not. attTCHSeizures here is the vendor TCH request count minus the requests that met all TCHs busy.

kpis.name: GERAN service abnormal release rate
kpis.source: 3GPP TS 32.410 V19.0.0 clause 8.2, without the intra-cell handover terms (not modelled)
kpis.operators_differ: Operators usually call a TCH drop rate their own formula; the Nokia-style dictionary carries no unsuccessful-handover counter, so it is computed for Huawei-style cells only.

kpis.name: Handover success rate (cell)
kpis.operators_differ: Internal only or including external (inter-BSC) handovers.

kpis.name: Call setup success rate
kpis.operators_differ: The most varied GSM KPI: vendors and operators multiply different SDCCH, TCH assignment and drop terms.

kpis.name: TCH blocking
kpis.operators_differ: Denominator with or without the blocked requests; handover requests counted or not.

kpis.name: SDCCH blocking
kpis.operators_differ: Denominator: immediate assignment attempts or SDCCH seizure attempts.

kpis.name: SDCCH drop rate
kpis.operators_differ: Which SDCCH releases count as drops. The Huawei-style dictionary carries no SDCCH lost-radio-link counter, so it is computed for Nokia-style cells only.

kpis.name: RRC setup success rate (with S1 signalling)
kpis.operators_differ: Revised by the operator: a set-up now counts only when the S1 signalling connection also succeeds. History is reprocessed; v1 and v2 are both kept.
